ns2:course.label: Elementary French II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of FR 101. Introduces cultural and supplementary enrichment materials; requires online laboratory sessions as in FR 101. Prerequisite: FR 101 or one year of high school French.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FR 101 or one year of high school French.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: All students in this course will be required to do language laboratory work outside of class.
